AN ORIGINAL JURASSIC ENGLISH STORY

The Bell That Rang Too Early

Level 2 · Development

Ages 8–10

Story + Workbook

JurassicEnglish.com · Storybook workbook edition

Chapter 1

Market morning

1

Every Saturday, Pavi helped her uncle at the small town market.
Her job was to ring a brass bell when the stalls were ready.
Ren, the new boy, liked to draw. He drew a fish stall, a flower stall
and Uncle’s mountain of hats.
‘You need a real job,’ said Pavi. ‘We all have to be useful.’
Ren closed his sketchbook. He sat behind the hats.
Read and circle
What does Ren do after Pavi says, ‘We all have to be useful’?
A. He keeps drawing Uncle’s mountain of hats at the stall.
B. He closes his sketchbook and sits behind the hats.
C. He rings the brass bell.
